title: Una revolución socialista
goal: Read how Cuba's government radicalized month by month -- nationalizing US-owned businesses, drawing closer to the USSR, and declaring itself socialist in April 1961.
grammar: Cada vez menos... cada vez más: describir una radicalización

items: Describe how the new government's attitude toward US companies shifted early on.
State what was nationalized without immediate compensation.
Explain what the USSR began doing as US sanctions increased.
Name what Castro declared publicly in April 1961.
Use cada vez menos... cada vez más to narrate a gradual radicalization.
